personalities.name: The Norseman’s Old Fashioned
personalities.description: You bring a steady hand and a strong sense of direction. You value experience, keep your promises, and know when a time-tested approach deserves a fresh twist. Your match blends aquavit, brown sugar and bitters with smoked oak and orange: a classic with Nordic character.

personalities.name: Port in a Storm
personalities.description: You’re the person people are glad to have beside them when plans change. You listen, bring people together, and make the busiest room feel a little calmer. Your match combines port, blackberry, warming spice and lemon: rich, smooth and welcoming, like reaching a sheltered harbour.

personalities.name: The Fjord Martini
personalities.description: You bring a clear head and a fresh perspective. Curious and observant, you spot the small details that help everyone see the way ahead. Your match pairs aquavit with elderflower, dry vermouth and lemon peel: crisp, floral and bright as a Nordic dawn.

personalities.name: Arctic Negroni
personalities.description: You bring curiosity, conviction and a taste for a different point of view. You enjoy connecting ideas and finding a new direction worth exploring together. Your match gives an Italian classic a Nordic turn with aquavit, Campari, sweet vermouth and orange: bold, bittersweet and full of character.

questions.label: Your place on the crew
questions.text: You’re bringing a team together for a new voyage. What do you naturally contribute?

answers.content: Experience and a dependable plan everyone can trust.
A welcoming atmosphere where everyone feels part of the crew.
Thoughtful questions that make the way ahead clearer.
A fresh idea that gets everyone excited about the possibilities.

questions.label: When the wind changes
questions.text: A last-minute change reshuffles your day. What’s your first instinct?

answers.content: Check in with everyone and help them regroup.
Look for an unexpected opportunity in the new plan.
Draw on what’s worked before and take the next practical step.
Get a clear picture of what’s changed before deciding.

questions.label: Worth a toast
questions.text: At the end of a successful voyage, what feels most worth celebrating?

answers.content: We discovered something new and opened up possibilities.
We learned something useful to carry into the next voyage.
We looked after each other and came back a closer crew.
We delivered what we promised, from start to finish.
